notes.title: Mac version restored
notes.notes:
Well, that was an adventure. Something must have changed with Steam's HTTP upload, because the Mac version had some aliases get broken during the upload. With some help, I managed to upload the Mac version the *right* way, so the game made it up in one piece.

Long story short, the Mac is Bac! Again.

*runs*
